package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.util.Locale;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;

/**
 * Assigns the owner's {@code customerCode}, formatted {@code <CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>} where CITY3 is
 * the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of
 * lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of
 * owners already in that city (e.g. {@code SYD-SMI-0007}). Runs after {@link BuildOwner} builds the
 * entity and before {@link SaveOwner} persists it, mutating the built owner in place so the saved
 * and returned record carries the code.
 */
public class AssignOwnerCustomerCode {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        String city = owner.getCity();
        String city3 = city.substring(0, Math.min(3, city.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String lastName = owner.getLastName();
        String last3 = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        long inCity = ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
                .filter(existing -> city.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getCity()))
                .count();
        long sequence = inCity + 1;
        owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
    }
}

```

```

All function classes are in package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`.

## 2. Java function classes referenced by the YAML (full source shown above in the transcript)

Key mechanics to note for editing:
- OfficeFloor DI conventions: `@Val OwnerFieldsDto request` / `@Val Owner owner` reads a pipeline variable; `Out<T>` writes one; declaring an `OwnerRepository` parameter injects the repo; escalations are declared via `throws`.
- `ValidateOwner.java` — `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated)`. Entry point; validates the body and publishes it as the `OwnerFieldsDto` variable.
- `NormalizeOwnerEmail.java` — mutates `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` (lower-cases email).
- `NormalizeOwnerAddress.java` — mutates address; `throws InvalidAddressException`. Contains `static String normalize(String)` (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST/RD/AVE) — reused by the household checks.
- `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java` — mutates telephone to E.164; `throws InvalidTelephoneException`. Contains `static String toE164(String)`.
- `CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique.java` — iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()`; `throws DuplicateTelephoneException`.
- `CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java` — iterates `findAll()`; bypassed if `sharesHousehold=true`; `throws DuplicateHouseholdException`. Has `static boolean sameHousehold(...)` and `static String normalize(String)`.
- `BuildOwner.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner> built)`; maps DTO->entity, defaults `registrationDate` to today.
- `AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java` — **this is where owners are counted by city**: `long inCity = ownerRepository.findAll().stream().filter(e -> city.equalsIgnoreCase(e.getCity())).count();` then formats `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.
- `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber.java` — sets `<customerCode>-M<YY>`.
- `AssignOwnerHousehold.java` — assigns shared `householdId` (SHA-256 derived) when opted in.
- `CountOwnerNamesakes.java` — counts existing owners with matching first+last name via `findAll()`.
- `SaveOwner.java` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps to `OwnerDto`, sends `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` via `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<OwnerDto>>`.

## 3. Owner entity and OwnerRepository

Entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (extends `Person`).
Repository interface: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java`
Implementations:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jdbc/JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/springdatajpa/SpringDataOwnerRepository.java`

Repository method signatures:
```java
Collection<Owner> findByLastName(String lastName) throws DataAccessException;
Page<Owner> findByLastName(String lastName, Pageable pageable) throws DataAccessException;
Owner findById(int id) throws DataAccessException;
void save(Owner owner) throws DataAccessException;
Collection<Owner> findAll() throws DataAccessException;
Page<Owner> findAll(Pageable pageable) throws DataAccessException;
void delete(Owner owner) throws DataAccessException;
```

**There is NO count-by-city (or find-by-city) method on the repository.** The only way to count owners in a city today is to load all owners via `findAll()` and filter in memory — exactly what `AssignOwnerCustomerCode` does. If you add a city-capacity rule you'd either follow that same `findAll().stream().filter(...).count()` pattern or add a new method to `OwnerRepository` and all three impls.

## 4. DTOs

There are no `OwnerRequest`/`OwnerResponse` classes. The DTOs are OpenAPI-generated from `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (build-time codegen; the `.java` files are not in `src`). They live in package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`:

- `OwnerDto` — the response (schema `Owner`, `allOf` OwnerFields + read-only fields).
- `OwnerPageDto`, `ValidationMessageDto` — supporting.

`OwnerFields` (request) properties: `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city` (string, minLength 1, maxLength 80), `telephone`, `email` (optional), `registrationDate` (optional), `sharesHousehold` (boolean, not persisted). Required: firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone. Note: `postcode`/`addressLine1` are referenced by future test helpers but are NOT yet in the schema.

`Owner` (response) adds read-only: `id`, `displayName`, `initials`, `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount`, `membershipTier`, `locality`, `pets` (required). To add a new response/request field you edit `openapi.yml` here and the mapper. Mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` ignores `id`/`pets`; `toOwnerDto(Owner)` computes `displayName`/`initials` via expressions (other derived fields come from the entity getters).

YAMLs in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/` map an exception class name (the filename) to a handler `class`. Java handlers in package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/.../rest/escalation/`.

| Escalation YAML (exception) | Handler class | HTTP status |

| `...DuplicateHouseholdException.yml` | `DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler` | 409 CONFLICT |
| `...DuplicateTelephoneException.yml` | `DuplicateTelephoneExceptionHandler` | 409 (analogous) |
| `...InvalidAddressException.yml` | `InvalidAddressExceptionHandler` | 400 BAD_REQUEST |
| `...InvalidTelephoneException.yml` | `InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler` | 400 (analogous) |
